d: A happy couple on the verge of marriage have their plans derailed when David comes across the love that got away from his past.

t: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
d: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.
Jamal decides to go to work with Charles and ends up temporarily blinding himself. Stacy challenges Charles to take care of the twins for the weekend while Tasha nurses Jamal.

When Jamal's city council opponent, Blanche Taylor, begins to use dirty tactics, Tasha and Charles help him fight back. Tasha's baby boutique goes national. After Crystal decides to get a tattoo, Kita and Stacy consider getting inked.
Charles encourages Stacy to go out with Dr. Sutton in order to avoid attending cultural events that he hates. Jamal and Tasha jump through hoops to get the twins into a prestigious pre-school.

As Stacy & Kita try to help Crystal "the Diva" plan her faux-wedding to Darkanian, Crystal reveals that she is reconsidering the marriage. Jamal's new campaign manager, Curtis Simmons, aggravates Tasha and Charles.
Stacy tries to convince Charles to join her MMA class that is taught by the buff instructor, Matt. After losing a debate to Blanche Taylor, Jamal considers dropping out of the election.
Tasha, being insecure, worries that her relationship with Rick Fox has no future, so she starts playing the field.
Derwin helps Jason try to win Kelly back, putting an end to all divorce talk, but then things go not as planned.
Jason loses his mind when he finds Kelly on a date with another man named Joe, in the car he gave her for a gift.
During an exclusive interview with Extra's Tanika Ray whatever, Robin Givens insinuates that Malik is gay, and for that reason, he wants to break up with her.
Stevie and her mother move in with Nikki and Kim.
Earvin ‘Magic’ Johnson hires Nikki to manage his movie theater.
When Professor Oglevee loses his job, he turns to Nikki for more than just moral support.
The Professor has a one-night stand with Nikki.
Nikki prepares to marry the Professor.
Nikki fights to restore the Professor’s job.

Hazel debates telling Regina F.A.I. didn't approve her and argues with Nigel over their wedding. David and Gary bond over their wives. Bree learns Dr. Reynard endorsed someone else. The women believe David's cheating on Ari.

st: This Is How We Do It
d: Bree, Jayla, Hazel and Versace, travel to Albany to search David's apartment for evidence of his affair. Hazel tries to reach Nigel, their drama going from bad to worse. Gary attends a men's retreat with David - competition gets the better of them.

Bree grapples with feelings for Dr. Reynard as she goes through her final interview for the Chief of Staff position. Jayla finds evidence that will win Maxine's case for her. David makes a surprise announcement about his political future.

Hazel is ready to tie the knot and find a way to show Sony she knows what's she's doing. Bree gets the Chief of Staff position, but at what cost? Jayla's case "win" and junior partner offer is questioned. David learns the truth about the break-in.

As the family and Darkanian shoot Jamal's campaign commercial, Darkanian injures himself, causing his boyfriend Greg to come "out" to the rescue. Stacy and Tasha believe their mother, Jaunita, is having an affair.

As election day approaches, Jamal and Tasha are mortified when Blanche releases an incriminating video of them. Charles' beard has grown to an embarrassing length and Stacy alters her own appearance to convince him to shave.

Much to Charles' dismay, Stacy and Tasha decide to tag along on Charles and Jamal's fishing trip. After Crystal helps Kita write a love letter to Troy, Kita returns the favor by trying to reunite Crystal and Rashad.
Stacy gets caught up in a sting at a massage parlor and becomes a mentor to women while in jail. When Jamal and Tasha go house hunting the search proves difficult when they disagree.

When Charmaine informs Tasha and Jamal that their new home was the scene of a triple homicide, they move in with Charles and Stacy. Crystal decides to lose her virginity to Rashad. Troy takes Kita on a romantic getaway.

Stacy and Tasha butt heads over their temporary living situation. While stranded on an island, Kita becomes annoyed with Troy's lack of survival skills. Crystal's activism causes her to lose track of her final exams.
The Devil Girls perform on the Santa Monica Pier. Jelena schemes to create a destructive love triange while Terrence keeps a secret from her. Ahsha demands answers about Sloane's past.

The power goes out at Devils Arena before a game leaving Ahsha trapped in an elevator with Derek. Pete confides a secret to Raquel and is shocked by Sloan once again. Jelena comes face to face with someone from her past.
